fun plan() {
    val planRegistry = readRepoFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/plan-tools.md")
    val executionPlan = compute(registry = planRegistry)
    val taskContext = readRepoFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
    val evidence = compute(context = taskContext, plan = executionPlan)
    writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", content = evidence)
    publish(channel = "safeoutputs.noop", body = "No action needed: consolidated preflight evidence written to /tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json.")
}
